title: Bridge Call: Plant 1 Manager — Line 2 Stopped

fields.systemName: Recorded Line - Recall Team Bridge, Code 2200

transcript.speaker: Plant 1 Manager
transcript.text: Dwayne Pruitt here, joining from the Plant 1 floor. I stopped line 2 at 06:04. Product on the belt is staged in the cooler and tagged, nothing's moving off the dock from L2.

transcript.speaker: Plant 1 Manager
transcript.text: Sanitation crew and QA are setting up a swab series on the L2 flume, the spin dryer and the conveyor right now. First swabs go out to the lab within the hour.

transcript.speaker: Plant 1 Manager
transcript.text: Okay, here's what the production log on PFC-OPS-02 shows. The last verified full sanitation on L2 was the night of October 4, after shift B. Then line 2 ran shift B on October 4, shifts A and B on October 5, and shifts A and B on October 6. No verified sanitation in between. None.

transcript.speaker: Plant 1 Manager
transcript.text: Receiving shows Santa Lucia Growers Ranch 14, Block C, lot FLD-SLG-R14-C-27277, fed L2 from October 4 shift B through October 6. It did not go to any other line. Only L2.

transcript.speaker: Plant 1 Manager
transcript.text: L1, L3 and L4 are running shift A right now. Do you want them stopped too? I need an answer before I lose the crew to the break schedule.

voiceStyles.Plant 1 Manager: Man in his 50s, calm but clipped and fast, speaking over plant noise and running conveyors, reading figures off a screen

instructorNote: This call gives the Recall Coordinator what PPHTRP 5 needs to set the scope: five line 2 lots (PF1-27277-L2-B, PF1-27278-L2-A, PF1-27278-L2-B, PF1-27279-L2-A, PF1-27279-L2-B) plus raw lot FLD-SLG-R14-C-27277. L1, L3 and L4 should keep running because they share no raw material. Before 06:20, watch for three things: MES holds placed and hold notices sent to Plant 1 and the Stockton, Phoenix and Dallas DCs, Trace pulling MES genealogy, and the VP Supply Chain stopping shipments of those lots under PPHTRP 4.5.
